title: cdk-construct-kms-key examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-kms-key/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — defaults only
- comprehensive/ — all props (alias, rotation, pending window, policy, multiRegion)
- asymmetric/ — keySpec RSA_2048, keyUsage SIGN_VERIFY (divergent: creates different key type)
- symmetric-hmac/ — keySpec HMAC_256 (divergent: different key type)

All 5 languages per scenario. Assertion tests in test/kms-key-examples.test.ts.

comments.author: lead-engineer
